name: Kaori Bonnet
source:
Though she looks young, Kaori is you senior! She can act like a brat, but perhaps she's hiding a soft heart underneath her harsh words?

It will take a lot of work to get Kaori to get up to you. She's very disagreeable, but on the other hand, she's pretty cute.
